new_failures.failed_witness: An initial PowerShell ancestry projection failed because a semicolon was embedded in an expression position.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered only the missing source topology facts with short scalar probes.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep ancestry checks as independent scalar commands before composing a presentation object.

new_failures.failed_witness: The source-manifest wrapper replayed all four manifests but its final aggregate crashed after a path variable shadowed the intended collection.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered only the missing aggregate scalar while retaining the complete per-manifest replay.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use distinct names for manifest paths and accumulated entry collections.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first sparse-checkout add attempted an unsupported no-cone flag and was rejected before index mutation.
new_failures.recovery: Used the documented add --stdin form with the exact bounded pattern list.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Probe the installed Git sparse-checkout help before relying on optional flags.

new_failures.failed_witness: The fresh no-checkout sparse worktree initially exposed an empty index and apparent mass deletions after sparse patterns were added.
new_failures.recovery: Stopped before staging and materialized the exact inherited index once with read-tree -mu HEAD, returning the lane to clean state.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize a no-checkout worktree index before generating or staging owner files.

new_failures.failed_witness: A case-insensitive PowerShell hashtable rejected upper- and lower-case replacement keys as duplicates before any file write.
new_failures.recovery: Repeated the mechanical projection with an ordered pair array and verified the resulting files.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use ordered replacement pairs when case-distinct tokens must be transformed on Windows PowerShell.

new_failures.failed_witness: A Windows ripgrep call used literal wildcard path arguments that the executable could not resolve.
new_failures.recovery: Reran only the missing audit with explicit file paths.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Pass explicit files or use glob options instead of shell-style wildcard path literals on Windows.

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell audit wrapper parsed a double-quoted ripgrep alternation as an expression and tried to load a token as a module before the audit ran.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered only the missing search with a single-quoted literal pattern and then compiled the builder separately.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use single-quoted literal search patterns for PowerShell alternations and keep compilation as a separate scalar probe.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined source-ledger and source-verification patch was atomically rejected because one inherited field block differed from its expected template spelling.
new_failures.recovery: Applied only the independently verified source-ledger and field-name hunks after inspecting the live file.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Split domain content and structural field migrations into separately attributable patches.

new_failures.failed_witness: A long integrated-overview patch was atomically rejected because one wrapped prose line did not exactly match the live file.
new_failures.recovery: Read the exact bounded overview and applied only verified semantic sections in smaller hunks.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect live wrapping and use bounded prose patches instead of one speculative large hunk.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first exact-source novelty diagnostic quarantined ten titles above the declared token-neighbour threshold and earned zero novelty credit.
new_failures.recovery: Retained the failed diagnostic, rewrote only the ten quarantined titles with more specific horology obligations, and reran only the failed novelty dependency.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Freeze titles only after the exact-source audit reports zero exact collisions and zero quarantined neighbours.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first failed-novelty receipt backup wrapper used incompatible Split-Path parameters and copied an exact duplicate into the worktree root after its destination projection failed.
new_failures.recovery: Used the resolved source path and platform path-directory helper, verified the intended retained receipt matched the accidental duplicate byte-for-byte, then removed only the untracked duplicate.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use System.IO path helpers for already-resolved literal paths in bounded Windows wrappers.
